title: Setting
description: Formal spec REQ-6-11/REQ-6-12. The value of policy.recovery, policy.removal, or policy.deactivation.threshold -- not policy.membership, which excludes "any" (see policy.schema.json's own inline schema for it). The number of guardian approvals a value actually requires is computed by REQ-6-8's three-step algorithm, not by the value alone.
